ui.description1: Check core manufacturing hazard factors such as machine entanglement,
ui.description2: high-temp burns, and chemical exposure. View detailed images.

list.title: Plating Tank Chemical Replenishment and Metal Surface Pickling
list.hazard: Asphyxiation from acid gas, chemical burns from splashing
list.measure: Verify local exhaust operation, wear impermeable chemical suits and gloves

list.title: Injection Molding Nozzle De-clogging and Carbon Cleaning
list.hazard: Burns from hot resin ejection, body crushing during unit movement
list.measure: Wear heat-resistant gear, implement LOTO, and perform low-speed/low-pressure purging

list.title: Logs Cutting and Processing Using Industrial Circular Saws
list.hazard: Gloves caught in rotating blades, timber kickback impact
list.measure: Wear snug-fitting workwear, use mandatory push sticks

list.title: Production Line Conveyor Belt Drive Unit Regular Maintenance
list.hazard: Finger caught between rollers, crushing due to unexpected startup
list.measure: Attach individual LOTO devices, inspect only while equipment is stopped

list.title: Melting Furnace Raw Material Charging and Molten Metal Casting
list.hazard: Steam explosion (splash) on moisture entry, radiant heat burns
list.measure: Perform pre-heat drying, wear shaded heat-resistant face shields always

list.title: Spot Welding Robot Maintenance and Tip Replacement
list.hazard: Collisions from robot malfunction, burns from hot tip contact
list.measure: Restrict cell entry and implement LOTO, use dedicated tip removal tools

list.title: Press Die Change and Setup in Manufacturing Process
list.hazard: Crushing between beds during die descent, collision during lifting
list.measure: Install standard safety blocks, perform vertical lifting and use guide ropes

list.title: SMT Production Line Operation and Reflow Oven Maintenance
list.hazard: Burns from hot heater contact, lead/flux poisoning in solder
list.measure: Work only after equipment cooling, wear gas masks for organic compounds

list.title: Internal Precision Cleaning and Disinfection of Large Food Mixers
list.hazard: Oxygen deficiency in tanks, crushing from unexpected blade rotation
list.measure: Monitor oxygen concentration, assign external watchman, implement main power LOTO

list.title: Large Offset Printer Roller Inspection and Solvent Cleaning
list.hazard: Finger crushing at nip points, fire from solvent vapors
list.measure: Use 'Inch' mode, verify operation of static elimination devices
